name: ジャパニーズ ラーメン 五感
note: Top of tabelog's Ikebukuro ramen ranking and a Michelin Bib Gourmand pick. Domestic ingredients only, a lunch service of three or four hours, reservation required. Counter seating, so one cover is the norm.

name: 麺屋 Hulu-lu
note: Clear shoyu broth in a Hawaiian-looking room. A tabelog top-100 regular and the one Ikebukuro ramen shop that turns up on every list. Small, counter-led, fast turnover.

name: 味噌麺処 田坂屋
note: Nine counter seats and nothing else. Opened 2023 by a cook out of Misomenshokoro Hanamichian and made the top 100 in its first year. Miso ramen ¥980. There is a queue, but it never shuts for the afternoon, so go off-peak.

name: 宍道湖しじみ中華蕎麦 琥珀 池袋店
note: Clam broth, completely clear, no fat to fight through. The one to pick when you want noodles but not a heavy afternoon.

name: MENYA NAKAGAWA
note: Niboshi-forward bowls with a serious following. Counter only.

name: 麺処 花田 池袋店
spot: 東池袋1-23-8 東池袋ISKビル1F
note: Counter-led miso shop that reviewers rate among the best in Tokyo. Free garlic to punch it up, thick noodles that hold the soup, a pile of bean sprouts. Under ¥1,000.

name: 塩そば専門店 桑ばら
note: Shio and nothing but shio. Quiet room, quick in and out.

name: 皇綱家
note: The iekei bowl in Ikebukuro that the rankings actually back. Tonkotsu-shoyu with depth rather than sheer weight.

name: 六坊担担面
note: Proper dandan, soup or dry. Counter seats along the wall.

name: ラーメン二郎 池袋東口店
note: All counter, ¥850, permanent queue. Hours have been cut back, so check before you give up an afternoon to it.

name: 東京アンダーグラウンドラーメン 頑者
note: Very thick seafood-pork tsukemen. One bowl is a whole meal and then some.

name: カラシビ味噌らー麺 鬼金棒 池袋店
note: You dial the chilli and the sansho numbness up or down yourself, which makes it the reliable pick on a day you want heat. Counter only.

name: 鶏の穴
note: The old guard of thick chicken paitan here, right on Meiji-dori. Under ¥1,000 and open late enough to be useful.

name: 無敵家
note: The shop outsiders mean when they say Ikebukuro ramen: heavy tonkotsu-shoyu that somehow finishes clean. Open until dawn, multilingual menu, and a tourist queue at almost any hour. Worth it once, then go at two in the morning.

name: らぁ麺 はやし田 池袋店
note: Clean, well-made shoyu. The safe answer when you don't feel like gambling, and comfortable to sit at alone.

name: 瞠 池袋店
note: Known for the dry seafood mazesoba rather than the soup bowls. Cheap, quick, counter.

name: 中国家庭料理 楊 2号店
note: The dry dandan noodles Kodoku no Gurume made famous. Counter plus a few tables, and reviewers describe a room full of people eating alone. Heat is adjustable; ask for less if you mean it.

name: 中国家庭料理 楊 別館
note: Same family, the building on the main road, and by several accounts the actual filming location. Dry dandan with fresh noodles ¥1,100, extra chilli and sansho on request. One reviewer walked in to find every seat taken by someone on their own.

name: 知音食堂
note: Sichuan and dim sum a minute from the east exit. Tops Retty's list of Ikebukuro Chinese places that are easy to walk into alone.

name: 沸騰小吃城
note: The third and roomiest of the north-exit Chinese food courts. Stalls split by province — Hunan, Hubei, Sichuan, Shanghai, Hong Kong dim sum — ordered from your phone and delivered by robot. Nobody minds if you buy one cup of tea, which makes it the softest possible way into regional Chinese food alone.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: 友誼食府
note: The original north-exit food court and still the best sampler: Fujian, Shanghai, Chongqing, Hunan and Hubei at separate counters, photo menu on your phone, food carried to the table. Packed at peak.

name: 新珍味
note: Seventy years old, seven counter seats downstairs and tables above. Order the taro-men or taro rice and the steamed chicken. Meat fried rice ¥990, gyoza ¥530. Works as a solo drink as much as a meal.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: 開楽 本店
note: Since 1954, and a tabelog top-100 gyoza shop. The jumbo gyoza are too big for one bite. Down a narrow lane just across Meiji-dori, with queue positions painted on the pavement. On Retty's solo-friendly list as well.

name: 地球飯店 池袋店
note: Regional Chinese cooking that still works as one plate and a bowl of rice. On Retty's solo-friendly list.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: 定食 美松
note: Founded in the 1950s, down a quiet lane a step off the noise, and first in tabelog's Ikebukuro set-meal ranking. Where to go when you want to eat without being in a crowd.

name: ランチハウス ミトヤ
note: A 1999 western-style diner, tabelog top 100 in 2021, laid out along a counter. Grilled pork set ¥710, the three-fry set ¥960, chicken katsu that hangs off the plate, and cabbage, curried pasta, rice and pork soup with everything. Fried to order in front of you.

name: 洋庖丁 池袋店
note: Tabelog top 100 for set meals. Steak and hamburg plates, a counter lined with men eating fast, and a turnover quick enough that the queue never really builds.

name: キッチンYAMITUKI
note: Counter only, so the room is mostly people on their own — Retty's reviewers say exactly that. One minute from the west exit.

name: 肉野菜炒め ベジ郎 池袋東口店
note: Stir-fried pork and vegetables, with the vegetable pile adjustable upward. Counter dining, and the closest thing to eating your greens on this list.

name: 丸富食堂 池袋東口店
note: One floor up, five minutes from the east exit, and unrepentantly Showa. The mixed fry set ¥1,485 puts karaage, horse mackerel, a croquette and a menchi katsu on one plate, with free large rice.

name: 梟小路
note: Near Sunshine City. The set of the day is ¥580 — mapo rice, a small soba, a side — and you buy a ticket from a machine, so the whole visit happens without a word. Counter seating.

name: 伊東食堂
note: A neighbourhood diner out in Higashi-Ikebukuro 4-chome, away from the station crowds.

name: 和食堂 素
note: Careful Japanese set meals out by the tram line. Slower and quieter than anything near the station.

name: きむん家 池袋本店
spot: 西池袋3丁目 アークランド西池袋ビル
note: A minute from west exit 1b, run by two brothers, with a counter built for single diners and a wood-lined room modelled on a hanok. Sundubu and other set meals ¥600–1,000.

name: 火星カレー
spot: 西池袋3丁目 グルメ通
note: First in tabelog's Ikebukuro curry ranking and a top-100 curry pick for 2026. Spice curry in a small room where eating alone is the default.

name: カリー・ザ・ハードコア
note: Out by Zoshigaya and as pointed as the name suggests. Worth the walk away from the station.

name: 北海道スープカレー Suage 池袋店
note: The Sapporo soup curry name, transplanted. Pick your heat, get a bowl and a plate of rice, eat alone without anyone noticing.

name: カレーの家
note: Small, cheap and highly rated — the sort of place that only really works for one or two people.

name: カレーは飲み物。池袋本店
note: The flagship of the chain, and the everything-on-top plate is genuinely excessive. Counter, fast, under ¥1,000.

name: Putali Cafe
note: Nepali dal bhat — a plate designed around one person eating it.

name: plAin
note: Spice curry in Higashi-Ikebukuro 4-chome, well away from the station churn.

name: A-RAJ
note: Raj, from Chennai, cooked at Ajanta — the shop that started South Indian food in Japan — before opening this in 2002. Thirty-six curries across vegetable, pulse and chicken, meals and dosa, with vegan options. One minute from Higashi-Ikebukuro; closures are irregular, so check before going.

name: TOMBOY 池袋東口店
note: South Indian rather than the usual north, so thinner sauces and a different spice register. The biryani is Hyderabad-style, cooked from raw rice under a dough seal, and takes time to arrive. Dosa and vada for the vegetarian side.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: うちたて家
note: Musashino udon since 2002, tabelog top 100 twice, and first in the Ikebukuro udon ranking. Dense, chewy noodles with cold dipping broth; ask for softer if you want it. Ticket machine outside, counter and tables inside, a queue before opening.

name: あんぷく 池袋店
note: Two minutes from the station, top 100 for udon in 2024. Beef tendon curry udon is the order; portion size is free to choose. Udon shop by day, drinking spot by night.

name: 硯家 本店
note: Curry udon done properly, and third or fourth in the local udon ranking depending on the week.

name: かるかや
note: On the roof of the Seibu store, and the Kodoku no Gurume episode. Thick chewy udon for ¥410, eaten outdoors under open sky. As a piece of solo eating it is close to perfect on a clear day.

name: 凛や 西武池袋店
note: Inside the Seibu ticket gates, and rated the best value of the station soba stands here. Standing, three minutes, done.

name: 爽亭 池袋店
note: Inside the JR gates from half six. Run by a Nagoya company, so the kishimen is the reason to come. Morning service adds fried tofu, wakame, tempura bits and spring onion.

name: たぬきは飲み物。
note: A tiny new-wave standing soba bar east of the station doing one thing — tanuki soba — at a level the format doesn't usually reach.

name: 十割手打ちそば 美蕎 -BIKYO-
note: Five minutes east, by Hareza. Buckwheat from Shichikashuku in Miyagi, milled in-house on a stone wheel, cut without wheat. Order a plain seiro at lunch and it is an easy solo visit.

name: 手打そば 宮城野
note: Hand-cut soba at the five-way junction east of the station, with a counter to sit at.

name: 松楽
note: Down the lane by Minami-Ikebukuro Park, four minutes out, and on Retty's solo-friendly list.

name: キッチンABC 西池袋店
note: Since 1969, and the one place every Ikebukuro solo-lunch blog agrees on. Hamburg, crab cream croquette and ginger pork sets land around ¥1,000. It queues before noon, but the turnover is fast and they take your order while you wait.

name: ウチョウテン
note: Tabelog top 100, seven minutes east, permanently queued. Eight in ten customers order the wagyu hamburg, which tells you what to do.

name: 宮崎亭
note: Miyazaki wagyu, no binder, eaten with salt. Turn up twenty minutes before opening and you may still wait.

name: キッチン Oh! Way
note: Ten minutes out from the east exit and still queued at lunch, which in this part of town means something.

name: 焼肉ライク 池袋東口店
spot: 東池袋1-40-3 池袋籏ビル1F
note: Eighteen of the twenty seats are single seats. Your own grill, iPad ordering, food inside three minutes, no bookings. A chain, and on the list anyway: it is the shortest path to grilled meat on your own.

name: ひとり焼肉 美そ乃
note: Eight seats, each with its own grill, and by the shop's own count 85% of customers come alone. A5 wagyu bought whole, so all 55 cuts are orderable a slice at a time, with a punch card for working through them. There is a cheaper Light menu for non-wagyu.

name: ぐんぼう
note: Shamo chicken specialist four minutes out, about sixty skewers plus whole-bird dishes. Plenty of counter, unfussy room. Liver ¥340, the four-cut shamo sashimi ¥2,100.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: 焼き鳥 しょうちゃん 池袋店
note: Domestic chicken killed that morning, skewered daily, cooked over binchotan. Rare cuts — chochin, nodobue, otafuku — and a counter, open until seven in the morning.

name: 立喰い寿し すしつね 東武池袋店
note: Standing sushi in the Tobu basement, cut in front of you at fair prices. Counter and standing tables, which is the point: four or five pieces and you leave.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: 回し鮨 若貴 池袋店
note: Twenty-seven counter seats on Sunshine 60-dori, six minutes from the east exit. Proper edomae at a price that doesn't need an occasion. Cards and QR payment accepted.

name: クンヤー
note: Twenty-four seats, two minutes from the subway, every member of staff from Isaan in Thailand's north-east. The sour-hot-sweet balance is the real thing rather than the softened version.

name: ジャスミンタイレストラン 池袋店
note: In the basement restaurant street, and deliberately not a street-food room: quiet, properly served, khao man gai and green curry around ¥1,200–1,400 at lunch. Useful when it rains.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: アガリコ食堂 池袋
note: Coloured lanterns out front, and Thai, Taiwanese, Singaporean and Vietnamese dishes on one menu. Good for a single plate and a beer.

name: 伯爵 池袋東口店
note: Up one floor, three minutes from the station, chandeliers and carvings and a Paris that never existed. The morning sandwich set with salad and a drink is ¥690; the pizza toast is the order. There are two branches, so try the other if this one is full.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: カフェ・ド・巴里
note: Automatic door, then an escalator, then chandeliers and a tropical fish tank. Breakfast runs until 14:00, pizza toast set with coffee ¥980, and the room is big enough that you can always sit down.
imageCredit: ホットペッパーグルメ

name: 純喫茶 マーガレット
note: Under the tracks by Higashi-Ikebukuro station, over forty years old, two floors, smoking upstairs. Morning set A ¥700; the parfaits are why it keeps reappearing online.

name: 三兵酒店
note: A bottle shop with a drinking counter attached, L-shaped, Ghibli drawings and the owner's hand-drawn bar map on the wall. Shochu highballs arrive as a full go, so pace yourself. Order the potato curry, served without rice.

name: たちのみや 喜平
note: Attached to a wholesale sake shop, so the oden is the food and the sake list is the reason. The gentlest standing bar around here to try first.
